```{r}
chum_data <- read_csv("~/R-with-Carl/20250730_AYKSSI_ASL_chum_export.csv")
```

```{r}
chum_data %>% 
filter(CollectionYear > 2010, StartLatitudeDD > 64)
```
#Get the growthrate of males (1) and females (2) separately in two new columns
```{r}
chum_asl <- chum_data %>% filter(is.na(AgeYRS)== F)
chum_asl %>% mutate(growthrate = LengthMM / AgeYRS, .after=LengthMM) %>% 
  mutate(Male = Sex=="1")
```
